tasks.description: Zero-resource operational repair for the just-completed backup recheck. The prior run correctly inspected backup status and found that external backup recoverability remains blocked by TimeoutError, with zero solver/plant/training/validation/test resources and no validation-bank/sealed-test access. However structured acceptance failed because the script's receipt evidence keys did not match the plan pass-condition names. This repair reads only the prior backup-recheck artifacts and emits a new structured receipt using exact pass-condition keys; it does not run backup, controllers, solvers, plant, training/refit, validation episodes, or sealed/final tests.
